name: constraint_resource_path_downstream_escape_denied
description: Root grants /src; the child claims the broader prefix /. Downstream certs can only narrow: the parent's /src constraint still evaluates against the request, so /etc/passwd fails constraint_denied. Downstream escape is impossible by construction.

verify_result.error_reason: constraint_denied: cert 1: constraint[0] (resource_path): requested path "/etc/passwd" is outside the authorized prefix "/src"
